note: UNDP post of 12 June 2026: 20 desktops handed over to support the Lehokela rollout, for deployment to selected stations and posts, said to support a move from manual, paper-based processes. The post does not say what the Lehokela application does, so it is unclassified and gives no fact; the computers are enabling.
